figure.teaching_claim: One shared twiddle product feeds a sum and a difference, and safe in-place code reads both old inputs before writing either paired output.

safe_update_order: READ both old a and old b
COMPUTE t, u, and v without writing
WRITE both slots only after both outputs exist
contract_verification.non_color_redundancy: Paths, operator signs, upper/lower labels, action verbs, numbered rows, and exact equations preserve meaning without hue.
contract_verification.math_rendering: Exact arithmetic and storage equations use the shared M/KaTeX renderer with palette-bound TeX roles.
contract_verification.implementation: Hook-free server component; M plus palette constants; inline styles; no Tailwind, dependency, or semantic figure root.

observed_defects: The graph fed old a only to the upper sum, although both u and v require a.
The shared-t branch merged with the upper-a line, making the two operator inputs visually ambiguous.
A formula-like footer remained inside SVG text rather than the KaTeX arithmetic ledger.
history.fix: Added both cross-branches, gave the crossing a panel-colored bridge gap, retained direct upper/lower labels, and reduced SVG prose to graphical labels while keeping exact formulas in KaTeX.

observed_defects: Light and dark desktop compositions passed, but four mobile SVG annotations were 9.5-10.5 viewBox units, below the 11-unit contract floor.
history.fix: Raised every SVG annotation to at least 11 viewBox units.

history.result: PASS: no clipping, collision, broken TeX, ambiguous arrow, theme failure, or mobile horizontal overflow was visible.

render_look_fix.mobile_method: The renderer's optional frame argument 360 forces the production mobile composition width of 312 px; ordinary production rendering remains prop-free and uses the equivalent max-width media rule.
